title: An Awesome Journaling App
content: I use DayOne daily for my God conversations. I have found it to be an awesome tool for journaling and keeping a record of my daily walk with God. I love it's ease of use, layout, look and ability to set up different journals for different types of conversations I have with God including keeping a record of things like promises, prophecies and dreams. I also especially love notifications like 'a year ago today' which draw you into to re-reading and enjoying old entries. DayOne is the perfect journaling tool and is completely adaptable to whatever purpose that you want to use it for. I love it and thoroughly enjoy the way it builds a record and history of my journey and relationship with God.  I have recommended the DayOne app to many people to use in the same way I have and many have gone on to use and enjoy this app as I have done.
author: Jon4Jen

title: Button delays
content: I had this happen on my iPad with Magic Keyboard. I updated the app and it sorted it self, now it is doing it again. Pretty much renders this app unusable. I hope you can sort it permanently. Happens when the entry is long. Also the arrow keys do strange stuff when trying to navigate, does not happen all the time but sometimes, never know. This app is becoming annoying, needs major fixing. It's becoming unstable. I will give it a bit longer hopefully you can sort this. I would pay for the full version but no way if its going to be like this. Un fortunate really, i thought it's great apart from this. So 1 star as without these problem fixed then i will look for something else.
author: speedski111

title: I loved it for years, but now, not so much.
content: A few years' ago I paid what was my second to largest ever amount of money for an app and downloaded DayOne. It was worth it because I loved it. I loved the design, but most of all I loved the peace and quiet of it. Then it became free, which was fine, as I had already got some good use out of it. Now, after having to download the latest 'free' version, it has become tainted with pop ups and annoying 'extra stuff' that only works on a premium subscription. It also takes longer to open (annoying when I have a thought or inspiration that I want to get written quickly) and its much more glitchy - something I have never encountered previously. I would be more than willing to pay a reasonably handsome one-off amount to have my peace and quiet back and to return to the original journal app. At least this version didn’t try and ram the 'premium version' down my throat.
author: Essedub

title: Online journal
content:
I have been using Day One for about four years now. I have found it invaluable. The act of journaling is so helpful and I like the daily prompts that give me good reflection and insight as I answer those questions. 
I had been using a manual journal and I do still write my hand for other things however I like to have this online so I can access it on my phone or wherever I am.
I have created various journals for various aspects of my life, and I am very grateful to have discovered this tool that gives me such insight into myself. I totally recommend this app.
author: Freya Harvey

title: Year of One Day
content:
I have been using One Day journal for about 9 years now and use it to record what is happening in our family. My journal is not a journal of deep and meaningful thoughts its a record of our family. Holidays, Weddings, births, deaths and achievements. 
My daughters love looking back at what I have recorded and the grand children always ask to see and read about when they were born. 
I love being able to add photos and also love being able to record special holiday diaries is seperate journals. 
I hope to keep adding to this journal for years to come.
author: Kay - NZ

title: Great journalling app but
content:
But its a right pain to get the photos to sync with the right day. The interface with the month calendar view is clunky. It would be better if the calendar view would have a little preview of photos like how the list view does. Because at the moment its just a grey square which tells me nothing.

The list view shows photo previews but its just a list so there is no context. Then theres the issue of trying to write a diary entry on a photo that was taken in a different timezone. It gets all messed up.
author: Sprint211

title: Makes journaling easy and fun
content:
Love this app! I printed several beautiful books detailing my solo travels and it’s a great fun looking through them. I tend to stop notebook journaling after a while because the act of picking up a pen after a long day at work gets tedious, but having an app makes this process so much easier! 
Only thing to mention is preview loading crashes for me for certain journals so I’m waiting to print them. It looks like this has been listed as known faults on the website so hopefully gets fixed soon!

title: “Wherever you need it- Only if you pay*”
content:
In an effort to make their Premium services more enticing, they have begun robbing free users of basic functionality.
I can no longer sync or access my journal across my devices. This basic, rudimentary feature that has been free for years and years has now been locked behind Day One Premium. It’s updates like these that have made me uninstall many other journal apps in the past. Greatly disappointing move. Day One will no longer innovate new ideas for their premium service and will systematically make the free experience as bone-dry and unbearable as possible.

title: The Journalling App That Keeps on Giving
content:
Having used Day One on a regular basis since 2013 on both iOS & Mac, it’s become one of those few apps that is truly indispensable.

It’s the go-to journaling app that’s packed with useful features, and makes you want to come back to it and capture the important moments in your life.

In 6 years of usage, I never had the need to contact support, since everything just worked. But on a minor occasion during hiccup with App Store subscription sync, the support team was fast, efficient and pleasant.

Thank you so much for putting your heart and soul into this wonderful app. ❤️

author: Lao DaGe

title: Life Changing
content:
If you are interested in journalling, this is the app to get. I have been using Day One for nearly four years now, previously only random days, more recently everyday single day. 

'On This Day' is an awesome feature and you really see its benefits after a couple of years of entries, prompting you to read what you wrote three years ago (and making you cringe because you find that you are STILL writing about the day you will start losing weight, exercising, giving up smoking etc that you did three years ago!). Point is, the power of this app is clear when you use it regularly. It's literally quantity and not necessarily quality when you log your life! Write whatever you like, just wrote everyday. 

Multiple journal feature is simply outstanding.

I love this app, it's features and the commitment from the Day One team to make continuous improvements. Thanks guys :-)
author: Shanejnz

title: Great fun
content: Actually really enjoying this app! Love the reminder each day, being able to add photos in from the album directly, the location information, daily temp. All the stuff that's cool to look back on. I've tried journaling in a book before and usually flag it after a few nights but I've found I'm quite keen to continue with this. You can also have several journals on the go at one time. So easy to jump from one to the other.  E.g., a daily one, a sports specific one, a recipe folder, etc etc - enjoying it so far.
